annotation.title_en: Organization Rules of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance (2001, current as amended to October 2026) setting out MLIT's internal organisation and the duties of its offices. It mostly covers administrative structure. A few posts touch embodied AI: an Automated Driving Technology Examiner for vehicle type approval, a Construction Automation Planning Officer, and an AI Utilisation Promotion Planning Officer.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines internal bureaus, offices and officer posts of MLIT and their responsibilities
Establishes an Automated Driving Technology Examiner handling type designation/certification of vehicles regarding automated driving technology
Creates a Construction Automation Planning Officer for automation of construction methods and machinery
Creates an AI Utilisation Promotion Planning Officer to plan the use of AI and digital technologies in MLIT affairs
Assigns recall supervision for non-conforming vehicles and specified retrofit devices
